name: Beyond the Threshold
description: The overworld is a sleeping colossus. A nameless cosmic entity watches through a gigantic human eye, black holes lens reality, the membrane of the world can be torn open with a blade, and the Radiate Reality glasses trigger the Mandela Effect: procedural shader realities from absolute realism to backrooms. All dimensions, blocks, skies and inventories are procedurally generated by the OnePac script.
